description: Shortlist coffee grinders for someone deciding which one to buy: "which grinder should I get for pour over under $200?", "a quiet grinder for espresso", "best hand grinder for travel". Ranks BrewMark's grinder finder by how they brew, budget, hand or electric, and must-haves, and returns each pick with an approximate US price, why it fits, and a link to its BrewMark buying guide. BrewMark does not sell grinders: do not use this to place an order, and for a grinder the user already owns use get_grinder_chart instead.

budget.description: Most they want to spend, in US dollars. Leave out for any price.

methods.description: Brew methods they will use. Leave out if they did not say.

must_have.description: Only if the user asked for it.

title: Find a grinder
